processing.aggregation: Day-weighted mean of 12 complete monthly means; incomplete years excluded; month 13 excluded
processing.scaling: NASA API values used as returned; dimensionless, no additional scaling
processing.quality: Fill −999, nonfinite and negative AOD excluded; no per-observation quality flags are supplied by this API
processing.uncertainty: HAC lag-1 intervals address limited serial dependence, not measurement error, higher-order correlation, model bias or causal inference. No multiple-testing correction; selectable windows are exploratory.
